## 4.1 Performance metrics comparison

## 4.3 Confusion matrices

At the default 0.5 threshold, in the same order as the table above:

- **Neural Network**: correctly identified 162 fatalities, missed 333 (false negatives), and triggered 296 false positives.
- **SVM**: correctly identified 200 fatalities, missed 295 (false negatives), and triggered 491 false positives.
- **Logistic Regression**: correctly identified 271 fatalities, missed 224 (false negatives), and triggered 1030 false positives.
- **Decision Tree**: correctly identified 141 fatalities, missed 354 (false negatives), and triggered 387 false positives.
- **Random Forest**: correctly identified 34 fatalities, missed 461 (false negatives), and triggered 13 false positives.

## 4.4 Deployed configuration

- Model deployed: **Neural Network (calibrated)**
- Selected as the highest test F1 on the Fatal class (0.340)
- Decision threshold: **0.0197** — chosen by maximising Youden's J (TPR - FPR) on a grouped validation split held out of the training data
- Isotonic calibration applied at the deployment stage only; the table above reports the models exactly as tuned in Deliverable 3.

Test metrics for the deployed configuration:

| Threshold | Accuracy | Precision | Recall | F1 | F2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Default (0.50) | 85.4% | 44.3% | 21.0% | 0.285 | 0.235 |
| Deployed / Youden J (0.0197) | 68.2% | 25.3% | 66.1% | 0.365 | 0.499 |
